lines.text: iPhones in China are finally getting Apple Intelligence. But part of the brain isn't Apple's.
On October 31st, Apple and Alibaba announced that Alibaba's Qwen AI will power parts of Apple Intelligence in China.
Qwen will work inside Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence, so you can ask about photos and documents, like PDFs.
Developers can test it in the iOS beta from November 4th. Everyone else gets it with iOS 27.3 in December.
Alibaba says it won't use your requests or answers to train its models. And you choose whether to switch it on.
One catch: the new, smarter Siri that Apple showed at WWDC isn't part of this first release.
Why it matters: Apple's AI finally reaches China, running on a local partner's model, a bit like ChatGPT inside Siri elsewhere.
